title: Warm Whipped Thai Feta Khanom Krok
description: A citrusy and aerated Thai dish featuring whipped feta and crispy lardons, served in a khanom krok mold, perfect for a snack or dessert. This raw-friendly treat is energizing and delicious.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Render the lardons in a pan until crispy and golden brown.
In a large bowl, whip the feta cheese until light and airy.
In a separate bowl, mix the coconut milk, lime juice, and palm sugar.
Add the eggs to the coconut milk mixture and whisk until smooth.
Add the rice flour to the coconut milk mixture and stir until combined.
Pour the coconut milk mixture into the whipped feta cheese and mix until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the khanom krok molds and top with crispy lardons.
Bake the khanom krok for 15 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden.
Remove the khanom krok from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve the warm whipped Thai feta khanom krok immediately.
